settings.heading: A second set of eyes, with experience.
settings.intro: Bring us your questions, plans, or simply a room that does not feel finished yet.
settings.body: Our complimentary consultation can cover proportion, placement, colour, layering, and care. Leave a note below and we will arrange a time that suits you.

settings.heading: Tell us about the room
settings.text: A floor plan, a photograph, or a few words is a perfect start.

settings.heading: Talk it through
settings.text: We listen first, then share a focused edit of possibilities.

settings.heading: Make it yours
settings.text: You decide at your own pace, with samples available on request.
